    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_marriage_allowed
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_marriage_disallowed
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:doctrine_clerical_marriage
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession_temporal_appointment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession_spiritual_appointment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession_temporal_fixed_appointment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession_spiritual_fixed_appointment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession_conditional
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:doctrine_clerical_succession
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_stoic
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_bewailment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_cremation
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_sky_burial
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_mummification
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_family_rites
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_grave_stake
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_green_pact
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_cannibalism
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_funeral_crystalization
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:doctrine_funeral
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_no_anointment
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_anointment_permitted
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_imperial_anointment
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:doctrine_coronation
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_monasticism_encouraged
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_monasticism_accepted
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_monasticism_absent
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_monasticism_forbidden
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:monasticism_group
      }
    }
    else_if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_sacraments_central
          var:ucm_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_sacraments_absent
        }
      }
      set_variable = {
        name = ucm_acm_pick_group_name
        value = flag:sacraments_group
      }
    }
  }
}
